label: The profile's selected relation at w, restricted to candidates that are…, by Inverse image of a…
rule: Inverse image of a well-founded relation (subrelation of the rank order on ℕ)
meaning: A natural-number rank decreasing along actual concrete grounding (OPEN) makes actual grounding well-founded: each grounding edge lies in the inverse image of < on ℕ. No excluded middle. This is a second, non-circular route to STMT-ACTUAL-GROUNDING-WF besides ACTUAL-GROUNDING-WF-FROM-BORROWING-CUT, from a strictly stronger premise.
